task_text: Get the house ready for bedtime in 15 minutes.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare any light objects in the kitchen for bedtime, such as slicing or pouring items.
central_instructions.R2: Navigate to the living room to assist with passing or receiving light objects.
central_instructions.R3: Prepare any light objects in the living room for bedtime, such as slicing or pouring items.
central_instructions.R4: Navigate to the kitchen to assist with passing or receiving light objects.
central_instructions.R5: Move any heavy objects in the bedroom to their bedtime positions and assist with light objects if needed.
central_instructions.R6: Move any heavy objects in the bathroom to their bedtime positions and assist with light objects if needed.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 SliceObject (apple) (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 PourObject (water into cup) (r1_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R1 SliceObject (lettuce) (r1_s3)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 navigate to the living room (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]

[10-15 min]
- R2 ensure all light objects are in their designated places for bedtime (r2_s3)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 PickupLightObject (r3_s1): Pick up the laptop from the table.

[5-10 min]
- R3 PassReceiveObject (r3_s2): Pass the laptop to another robot for safekeeping.

[10-15 min]
- R3 PourObject (r3_s3): Pour water from the pitcher into a glass to prepare for bedtime hydration.
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 navigate to the kitchen (r4_s1)

[10-15 min]
- R4 continue assisting as needed until the task is complete (r4_s3)
agent_plans.R5:
[0-5 min]
- R5 can_navigate to the bed and adjust the blanket to ensure it is neatly spread. (r5_s1)

- R5 can_navigate to the desk and push the chair under the desk to tidy up the area. (r5_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R5 can_navigate to the trash can and ensure it is positioned against the wall to clear the floor space. (r5_s3)
agent_plans.R6:
